title: Fusion 2026: Hardware Moves, Funding Decides

stats.label: US target for fusion deployment
stats.detail: DOE's June Fusion Science and Technology Roadmap is the central plank of a federal strategy to catalyse early plants by the mid-2030s.

stats.label: ITER tokamak sector modules installed
stats.detail: The sixth module went in on 28 July 2026, almost six months ahead of schedule; the final module is targeted for mid-2027.

stats.label: Record private fusion funding, 12 months
stats.detail: Fusion Industry Association figure for the year to July 2026; cumulative funding since 2021 reached $14.24 billion.

stats.label: FES appropriation vs $1.1B authorised
stats.detail: Congress appropriated $790 million for fusion energy sciences for FY2027, below the $805.7 million enacted previously.

stats.label: US fusion companies developing concepts
stats.detail: Most are pursuing tokamaks or stellarators; others use laser-based inertial confinement.

stats.label: Tritium half-life drives breeding need
stats.detail: Tritium is scarce on Earth; future reactors plan lithium breeding blankets to generate it.

quotes.text: "The plan isn't the problem. We all agree on the plan. The X factor is the funding. If we underfund the U.S. fusion program and we cut vital scope, we can all watch the timeline to commercialisation slip."
quotes.source: Robb Hughes, Realta Fusion, via Reuters

quotes.text: "This latest achievement is a visible marker of the progress being made through our accelerated approach to machine assembly."

As of 2025, the National Ignition Facility is the only laboratory to have demonstrated a fusion energy gain factor above one — but efficiencies orders of magnitude higher are required for engineering breakeven.
Private developers have not yet achieved "net energy gain," the point where a fusion reaction produces more energy than was used to start and sustain it.

takeaway: Fusion's 2026 story is fast assembly and record private capital against a materials-and-money bottleneck that still puts commercial power in the mid-2030s at best.
